verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner layout with the same problems. The subcopy is squeezed into a narrow column of five lines with orphans ('golden / hour.') and is too small to read. The decorative circles sit behind the 'NEW FLAVOR' pill and behind 'Light' in the headline, which looks accidental. The can and logo are tiny, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge. In A the SOLSTICE logo is also broken: the sun icon is shifted off-centre and clipped above the wordmark. B keeps the sun centred and the wordmark legible, so B is slightly better.
